item.title: Man killed, 2 injured in multi-vehicle DeKalb County crash
item.description: DeKalb County Police are investigating a multi-vehicle collision that left one man dead and two others injured Saturday afternoon.Officers responded to the scene at the intersection of Covington Highway and Glenwood Road at approximately 1:30 p.m.According to investigators, a chain reaction began when a driver pulling out of a driveway collided with an SUV. item.title: Groundhog Day 2026 predictions taking place early Monday
item.description: After three weekends in a row of winter weather, many across Georgia are probably wondering when spring will begin. Well, good news! Monday, three of America's favorite groundhogs will emerge once again to make a meteorological prediction for the start of the season. Punxsutawney Phil will emerge to make his annual weather prediction at sunrise on Monday. item.title: Juvenile shot by Clayton deputy after alleged carjacking
item.description: One juvenile was shot, and another was tased on Saturday night after the pair allegedly carjacked a woman and led law enforcement on a vehicle chase near Rex. Clayton County officers responded to an alleged carjacking at the intersection of Rex Road and Highway 42 in Ellenwood around 8:04 p.m. Saturday, police said. item.description: As a bitter cold grips North Georgia, keeping weekend snow from melting in some areas, several schools, including some in metro Atlanta, have decided to either cancel class or have a virtual learning day. item.title: Police investigating fatal shooting at Austell home
item.description: Police are investigating a fatal shooting that happened on Sunday morning at a home on Brightmore Drive, officials said. Officers responded to the home in the 4000 block of Brightmore Drive just before 6:30 a.m. after receiving a call about a person who was shot, police said.When they arrived at the home, police found a person suffering from a gunshot wound. item.title: Ancient disease poised to become second ever to be eradicated: The Carter Center

item.title: Boyfriend accused of stabbing woman at Clarkston apartment
item.description: Clarkston police are investigating after a woman was fatally stabbed early Sunday morning at an apartment complex. Officers responded to the complex in the 3000 block of Clarkston Industrial Boulevard around 2:30 a.m.When they arrived, police found a woman suffering from a stab wound to the chest. The woman, identified as 67-year-old Joyce Mitchell, died on the scene, police said.
